next_question.rationale: The top gap (created→confirmed lost 417,569; conversion 0.3548) is not fully explained by consultation_required: rx_gated has lower conversion (entered 255,293 → converted 76,641, rate 0.3002) but that only explains a minority of the 417,569 lost orders. I expect conversion to vary by hour_of_day because payment reliability, user attention, or availability of live support (for payment/help) can change by time and create concentrated drop-offs; if a few hours carry most abandons, fixing them is high-leverage. Also cut item_count because larger baskets may trigger more verification, higher price friction, or more stock failures and could account for a large share of created→confirmed loss (so set also_dimension to item_count).
